Construct a koine pass from design arrays (the IR-targetable builder)

Source: R/pass.R
koine_pass_from_design.Rd

The programmatic, re-entrant, deparse-free entry point a parent triangulation panel drives (flexyBayes backend-contract clause 1): build a pass directly from a named design matrix, a response, a family, and an optional grouping vector — no model formula, no match.call() capture, no session-global state. Two passes can be built and synthesised in the same process without interference. The stored design is used verbatim downstream, so non-syntactic canonical column names (e.g. (Intercept)) pass through untouched.

Usage

koine_pass_from_design(
  x,
  y,
  family,
  group = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  coef_names = colnames(x),
  response_name = "y",
  grouping_name = "g",
  required_outputs = c("posterior", "log_likelihood"),
  seed = 1L,
  obs_id = NULL,
  resources = list(allowed_tiers = 1L),
  prior = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A numeric design matrix with named columns (the fixed-effects design; include an (Intercept) column if wanted). Column names become the coefficient names (b_<col> in the draws).

y

The response vector (length nrow(x)).

family

A base-R family object or a known family name.

group

Optional grouping vector (length nrow(x)) for a single random intercept (1 | group); NULL for a population model. For the MET structure of two crossed/nested random intercepts pass groups instead.

groups

Optional named list of two grouping vectors (each length nrow(x)) for two crossed/nested random intercepts — the breeder-standard MET structure, e.g. list(variety = ., trial = .). The list names become the grouping-factor names; mutually exclusive with group.

coef_names

Optional column names for x (defaults to colnames(x)).

response_name

Name recorded for the response (default "y").

grouping_name

Name recorded for the (single) grouping factor when group is supplied (default "g"); ignored when groups is used.

required_outputs

Character subset of c("posterior", "log_likelihood", "posterior_predictive", "sample_stats").

seed

Integer master seed; per-lens seeds are derived from it.

obs_id

Optional character vector of observation ids (defaults to obs_0001-style labels of length nrow(data)).

resources

A list with allowed_tiers (subset of 1:3) and optional budgets; defaults to tier 1 only.

prior

Optional structured prior table (unused by the DRAM lens, which uses its own weakly-informative default; reserved for later lenses).

Value

A validated object of class koine_pass.

See also

koine_pass(), koine_opinion_draws()

Examples

set.seed(1)
x <- cbind(`(Intercept)` = 1, z = rnorm(40))
y <- 1 + 0.5 * x[, "z"] + rnorm(40)
pass <- koine_pass_from_design(x, y, gaussian())
pass$has_re             # FALSE -- a population model, built without a formula
#> [1] FALSE
